title: Removal of kanamycinR gene from Keio collection strain
author: Ben Kuipers
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7jqhkmw

steps.title: Prepare competent cells
steps.instruction: Prepare chemical competent cells of E. coli JW0336 using the mix and go protocol.

steps.title: Transform cells with pCP20
steps.instruction: Transform the prepared competent cells with plasmid pCP20.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml LB for a 1 hour recovery period
Centrifuge the eppendorf for 2.5 minutes at 11000xg
Resuspend the pellet and plate on LB + AMP plates

steps.title: Induce recombination and plasmid loss
steps.instruction: Inoculate three picked colonies into 5 mL liquid LB cultures.

substeps.instruction: Shake tubes overnight at 45ºC to induce FLP recombinase expression and select for the loss of pCP20

steps.title: Plate for single candidate recombinants
steps.instruction: Perform a 100-fold dilution of the overnight culture using fresh LB.

substeps.instruction: Plate 50 ul of the diluted culture on LB plates

steps.title: Screen for recombination and plasmid loss
steps.instruction: Pick 6 colonies from each plate and resuspend in MilliQ water.

substeps.instruction: Streak a small amount of the cell suspension on an LB plate without antibiotics
Divide the remaining solution dropwise over LB + AMP, LB + CHL, and LB + KAN plates

steps.title: Select and archive recombinants
steps.instruction: Identify and archive candidates that are sensitive to all antibiotics.
